0.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_1
0.description: Are you just seeking to pass the time, or do you have an honest interest in armorcraft?

1.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_Q1_000_1
1.description: What would you like to know?

5.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_2
5.description: Me? Hah! You must be new in Limsa. I'm H'naanza, the head of Naldiq & Vymelli's, forgemaster and shipwright.

6.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_3
6.description: I spend a good portion of my time here in the Armorers' Guild, trying to hammer my novices into something resembling true artisans.

7.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_4
7.description: We lost too many of our skilled veterans to that damn Calamity. Too many...

8.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_100_4
8.description: I see it as my Builder-given duty to not only pass on the techniques of the armorer to the next generation of artisans, but to improve on those processes as well.

9.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_5
9.description: At a glance, working a sheet of plate seems simple. You take your chosen metal, then heat, hammer, and bend until you achieve the desired shape and thickness.

10.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_6
10.description: There is, however, much more to the process. An armorer needs to learn how to work materials of varying hardness, such as bronze and iron. And shaping them into gauntlets, shields, and helmets is no easy task.

11.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_7
11.description: You must direct your blows with strength and surety as would a smitty, but an armorer needs something a smitty doesn't: delicacy. Without that, it wouldn't be long before tiny flaws crept in to compromise the defensive strength of the plate.

12.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_8
12.description: We make works of art with flame and steel, and there's never a day that I'm not damn proud to be an armorer.

13.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_010
13.description: Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Have you come to help hammer the dents out of some of my novices, or was there something else I could do for you?

14.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_020
14.description: Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Seems you've a knack for landing yourself in the midst of ugly situations. But not to worry─once the blaze dies down, the purity of your steel will be revealed for all to see.

15.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_021
15.description: Stay here as long as you please. My hammer and I will see to any characters foolish enough to seek trouble at <hex:021A020203>my<hex:021A020103> forge.

16.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_030
16.description: Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. How fares your work with Blanstyr? I know he can be a difficult old sod, but if any can show him the error of his ways, it is you.

17.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_040
17.description: Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I must thank you again for the patience you have shown with Blanstyr. As ever, you are the living embodiment of everything for which this guild stands.

18.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_050
18.description: Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I still have yet to receive word from Blanstyr. How am I to know if the old aldgoat even arrived in the Far East...?

19.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_060
19.description: Aye, I was finally handed a letter with atrocious penmanship telling me that a certain veteran artisan had safely found himself a Far Eastern tutor. Blanstyr can be trying, I know, but I would consider it a personal favor if you could keep an eye on him.

20.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_070
20.description: Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Again, I must thank you for overseeing Blanstyr's impetuous pilgrimage. Considering the knowledge you gained in the process, I expect great things from you as well!

23.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_A2_000_002
23.description: What can you tell me of armorcraft?

25.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_100
25.description: There has been scant trouble to speak of─especially since Blanstyr made the decision to distance himself from our forges.

26.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_101
26.description: But though the guild has been blessedly free of friction, this was not necessarily the outcome for which I had hoped.

27.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_102
27.description: Far better if he were to have embraced the idea of friendly rivalry. Alas, such a fundamental shift in perspective will not be soon in the offing for a stubborn old aurochs like him.

28.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_150
28.description: Now that Blanstyr is around the forges once more, I see my novices perspiring from more than the heat. It might be that they fear his tongue-lashings more than mine.

29.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_151
29.description: But judging by the increase in quality and production, sometimes a little pressure is not a bad thing. The old buzzard can be good for the guild...if we can steer him onto the right track.

30.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_160
30.description: I would like to say that Blanstyr has mellowed after his time working with you, but it seems he has merely swapped one brand of stubbornness for another─the old aurochs is perfectly serious about his contest with me.

31.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_161
31.description: But if he thinks to out-forge the forgemaster, then he had best think again. My work for Naldiq & Vymelli's comes first, of course, but I will sacrifice sleep to craft my competition pieces, if needs be.

32.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_162
32.description: ...I might be enjoying this rivalry despite myself. There is a certain thrill to matching one's work against a competitor that cannot be found in hammering out commissions. I am glad to have him back...

33.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_100_170
33.description: I was honestly surprised by Blanstyr's decision to leave on this pilgrimage of his. He is an asset to the guild and his absence concerns me, but an artisan must be free to pursue new methods and ideas.

34.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_110_170
34.description: If he returns a better armorer, then I shall not regret the time spent covering his clients' requests.

35.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_200_170
35.description: Blanstyr finally took the time to send me a letter─even if the contents were barely legible. Thank you for checking on his well-being.

36.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_210_170
36.description: If the old aurochs returns a better armorer, then I shall consider the time spent covering his clients' requests well spent.

37.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_170
37.description: Blanstyr's never been away for so long before. The lack of conflict is a touch unsettling, but I've been kept busy adjusting and repairing armor for his usual clients.

38.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_171
38.description: It was a strange thing to hear him talk about this pilgrimage. The stubborn bugger's always been at odds with his fellow armorers, and I never imagined he'd willingly seek out a teacher.

39.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_172
39.description: He's certainly changed for the better, and I look forward to seeing what learning these new techniques has done for the character of his work. Of course, as his rival this means I'll need to learn some innovation of my own!

40.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_200
40.description: With many of our best members sent off to Garlemald at the Admiral's request, we found ourselves hard-pressed to meet demand.

41.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_201
41.description: Until they returned, that is, and bearing all sorts of fascinating knowledge of imperial magitek.

42.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_202
42.description: It took a lot of trial and error, but we've managed to integrate these techniques with our own tried-and-true methods. I can't wait to see the look on Blanstyr's face when we show him our latest creations.

43.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_110
43.description: You wish me to lecture you like you were a fresh-faced initiate? An odd request, but not as uncommon as you might think. Very well─stand up straight, and pay attention!

44.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_111
44.description: At a glance, working a sheet of plate seems simple. You take your chosen metal, then heat, hammer, and bend until you achieve the desired shape and thickness.

45.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_112
45.description: There is, however, much more to the process. An armorer needs to learn how to work materials of varying hardness, such as bronze and iron. And shaping them into gauntlets, shields, and helmets is no easy task.

46.description: You must direct your blows with strength and surety as would a smitty, but an armorer needs something a smitty doesn't: delicacy. Without that, it wouldn't be long before tiny flaws crept in to compromise the defensive strength of the plate.

47.name: TEXT_REGSEAARMGUILD_00056_HNAANZA_000_114
47.description: We make works of art with flame and steel, and there's never a day that I'm not damn proud to be an armorer.
